capabilities: Delay the startup of selected plugins by a configured number of seconds
Toggle plugins from the command palette
Configure plugin settings in the manager's settings page
extras: The README only covers manual installation; the plugin had not yet been published to the community plugin list at the time of writing.
intentEvidence: A huge thanks to @TfTHacker for creating the original implementation of lazy loading
problem: Obsidian has limited built-in plugin management: all enabled plugins load at startup and toggling them requires navigating settings.

relations.evidence: the original implementation of lazy loading as found here

summary: Plugin manager that adds per-plugin startup delays (lazy loading) and quick toggling of plugins via the command palette and hotkeys.
